sourceRefs.locator: The Archaeology of York 8/5. Abstract and Period 4B on the properties; Structure 5/1, pp. 622–624 and fig. 212; provisional building chronology p. 798. The report dates wall timbers to winter 961/62 and identifies reused wood at the entrance.

Hall and colleagues, The Archaeology of York 8/5 (2014), p. 624, fig. 212, scale interval 0.1 m. Photographs credited collectively on p. 802. The publisher's online catalogue (item 74471) licenses the report under CC BY 4.0.
Monument MYO5075, Location: British National Grid SE 6044 5169. Converted to WGS84 and rounded for orientation.

labels.de: Die Bohlen eines Hauses auf Grundstück A
labels.en: The wall planks of a house on plot A

note.de: Die jüngsten erhaltenen Ringe ausgewählter Wandbohlen datieren ihre Fällung auf den Winter 961/62. Der Punkt zeigt das Haus, in dem die Hölzer verbaut wurden.
note.en: Growth rings from wall planks date their felling to the winter of 961/62. The marker shows the house where the timber was used.
